summary: Confirmed in the prepared source that Kimi-VL MoonViT shards its MLP and attention output projections by attn_tp_size while leaving both RowParallelLinear reductions on the default global TP group. Routed both reductions through the DP-attention TP group when DP attention is enabled. A constructor-level regression failed before the fix and passes after it, including the non-DP boundary case.

tests.what_was_measured: Issue-specific pre-fix regression: with tp_size=4, attn_tp_size=2, and DP attention enabled, MoonViT's attention output projection retained use_dp_attention_reduce=False. The DP-disabled boundary subtest passed. Raw output: reports/j-6fee7184e557/raw/failing-before.log

Both MoonViT RowParallelLinear sites select the DP-attention reducer when enabled and retain the global TP reducer when disabled; 1 test and 2 subtests passed. Raw output: reports/j-6fee7184e557/raw/passing-after-target.log
The complete Kimi-VL encoder-parallelism unit file passed: 5 tests and 2 subtests. Raw output: reports/j-6fee7184e557/raw/test-kimi-vl-full.log
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, credential, and registered-test validation hooks passed. Raw output: reports/j-6fee7184e557/raw/pre-commit.log
No whitespace errors. Raw output: reports/j-6fee7184e557/raw/diff-check.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned host exposes exactly one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 GPU. The reported failure requires at least TP4/DP2 and Kimi-VL weights, which were not available; no single-GPU smoke was substituted for distributed evidence. Inventory: reports/j-6fee7184e557/raw/gpu-inventory.log

remaining_limitations: The original Kimi-VL HTTP serving deadlock was not reproduced end-to-end because only one GPU was assigned and the Kimi-VL weights were unavailable.
The regression verifies actual MoonViT construction and both reducer-selection flags, but it cannot execute a TP4/DP2 collective schedule on one GPU.
No model semantic or numerical accuracy claim is made; this change only corrects communicator selection.
Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35831 independently proposes the same two source changes and remained open/review-required when inspected.
